shortDescription: Copy (if necessary) and install a new operating system on Comware v7 device

options.name: boot
options.description: File (including abs path) of the local boot package (.bin)

options.name: delay
options.description: If reboot is set to yes, this is the delay in minutes to wait before rebooting.

options.name: delete_ipe
options.description: If ipe_package is used, this specifies whether the .ipe file is deleted from the device after it is unpacked.

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP Address or hostname of the Comware v7 device that has NETCONF enabled

options.name: ipe_package
options.description: File (including abs path path) of the local ipe package.

options.name: password
options.description: Password used to login to the switch

options.name: reboot
options.description: Determine if the reboot should take place after device startup software image is configured

options.name: remote_dir
options.description: The remote directory into which the file(s) would be copied. See default.

options.name: system
options.description: File (including abs path) of the local system package (.bin)

options.name: username
options.description: Username used to login to the switch
